clauses.title: Essential Requirements (Table 1)
clauses.content: pH value must be between 6.5 and 8.5 without relaxation. Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) acceptable limit is 500 mg/l, permissible up to 2000 mg/l in the absence of an alternate source.

clauses.title: Bacteriological Quality
clauses.content: All water intended for drinking shall not contain E. coli or thermotolerant coliform bacteria in any 100 ml sample.

clauses.title: Toxic Substances (Table 2)
clauses.content: Lead (as Pb) max 0.01 mg/l, Arsenic (as As) max 0.01 mg/l, Fluoride (as F) max 1.0 mg/l (permissible up to 1.5 mg/l).
